summary.en: British guitar bands reclaiming local pop tradition.
summary.zh: 英国吉他乐队对本土流行传统的再宣称。

body.en: Britpop answers Grunge's gloom with bright melody and British identity. It looks back to Beatles/Kinks lineages and returns nineties UK rock to the public square.
body.zh: Britpop 以明快旋律与英国身份回应 Grunge 的阴郁。它回望 Beatles / Kinks 谱系，也把 90 年代英国摇滚重新推入大众视野。
